terrainCm.sample_scope: scene+seed; terrain standard deviation, not maximum height

radialError.additional_mechanisms: weak-signal uncertainty is separate; edge mixing precedes baseline radial error

wobblePhase.note: Circular phase; ordinary mean/std is not a useful summary

weather_factor_distribution: uniform, half-width sqrt(3)*std; actual relative std=5%, limits 짹8.6603% before UI-domain clipping
seed_contract: same scene, seed, settings and time reproduce the result; new seed resamples; redraw/tab/camera does not

spatial_contract.rain: Persistent world-cell Poisson particles with terminal advection; actual conical beam intersections; photon detections remain stochastic
spatial_contract.snow: Same world persistence, representative terminal speed 0.8m/s; no individual snow flutter
spatial_contract.fog: Wind-advected procedural density, photon-weighted stochastic returns; not CFD
spatial_contract.dust: Per-sequence source sampled from scene footprint; stationary world emitter and moving mass parcels
spatial_contract.sun: seeded false ranges in configured solar direction; azimuth/elevation remain user controls

asset_contract: 24 fixed DEMO layouts, 3 per family; weather seed does not move buildings, trucks or props
coverage_profile: tools/dataset-profile.cjs coverage-v22; review UI defaults unchanged
